item.description:
Shiori 1.0.4 – Recycle Bin & Quicker Folders

What's New

  • Recycle Bin: Deleted bookmarks now go to a Recycle Bin instead of vanishing — browse trashed bookmarks, restore the ones you want, or permanently delete them, with the local cache staying in sync with deletions from your other devices!
  • Quick Folder Creation: Right-click any bookmark, tag, or folder row to create a folder on the spot, plus New Subfolder on folder rows to nest one inside the folder you clicked!

Improvements

  • Smarter Bookmark URLs: The URL field is now clearly required, and URLs no longer need a scheme — example.com becomes https://example.com, host:port values like localhost:3000 are supported, and non-web schemes are rejected to match the server!

Bug Fixes

  • Clearer Import Feedback: Importing with no file selected now shows a clear "Select a file first" warning, and an import that adds nothing is honestly reported as "No Bookmarks Imported" instead of a false success!

Thank you for being part of the Shiori community! Your feedback drives every improvement we make.
